verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Titan as a FIDO/U2F authenticator that proves physical possession of the key, with a button press as the user action. It works with any service that supports FIDO CTAP1. That makes it a usable touch-to-approve primitive only if some other system builds the approval step around it. The probe confirms Titan has no CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface of its own, and every documented flow is account sign-in or 2-Step Verification. Missing for 10: documented use as a per-action approval gate for automated or agent-initiated operations, a first-party integration or developer surface for wiring key touches into agent workflows, and hands-on corroboration of such use.
